story: How long does a freezer stay frozen when the power goes out?
text: Technology Connections did a decent video that covers freezer design decisions like that and others: [VIDEO]

Combined fridge/freezer units use a heat pump to get the freezer really cold and residual cold air is cycled into the fridge. So having the freezer on bottom is not the optimal design, maybe because cold air is dense and will fall taking more active effort to distribute it. Source: [VIDEO]

story: Use Clean Energy Charging on Your iPhone
text: I should bring up that top opening chest fridges are actually pretty great for energy efficiency! [VIDEO] The amount of electricity needed is so small that it might even be comparable (mobile so i haven't calculated yet)

This reminds me of the Technology Connections fridge rant video. Similar arguments all around, the dumping effect of cold out of a vertical fridge is pretty crazy to watch with a thermal camera. [VIDEO]
Mostly yes. Upright fridge and freezer designs trade off efficiency for convenience (rooting around in a chest fridge/freezer can be annoying). [VIDEO]
